replacement.title: Main Shaft Geometry and Machining
replacement.definition: Specify the main-shaft stock and machined features, including the tube stock, internal machining, locking-thread geometry, keyway removal, and bushing-space dimensions.

patches.decision_note: Message 45 defines several main-shaft stock and machining constraints that evolve independently from the bushing-guidance and welded-lug mechanisms.
The generic approval of the overall drawings does not specifically verify dimensional annotations, and the preceding context covers several Requirements.

value_updates.delivery_sequence: Provide the final PDF drawing set for client confirmation before exporting the other agreed formats.

patches.decision_note: The client requests editable SolidWorks drawings but does not explicitly specify the SLDDRW extension.

Message 17 is listed as anchor evidence for the 3D-model and dimension-annotation Requirements but is absent from their Event histories; its raw text should be checked for an earlier introduction or modification.
The specified surface-finish value and tolerance field cannot be assigned safely without identifying the affected face or part.
